definitions.explanation: A saw powered by an electric motor, typically used for cutting wood, metal, or other materials. An everyday household/DIY term encompassing handheld reciprocating saws, jigsaws, and similar tools.

examples.english: To cut wood with a power saw.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホームセンター→ホームセンター：11152_hoomusentaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{電動|でんどう}のこぎり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a power saw at the home center.

examples.japanese: {電動|でんどう}のこぎり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧メガネ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}して→着用する：26849_chakuyousuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Be sure to wear safety goggles when using a power saw.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧ ('electrically powered') and のこぎり ('saw'). The word のこぎり is almost always written in hiragana, even though the kanji ⟦{鋸|のこぎり}→鋸：05477_nokogiri⟧ exists. A common DIY and hardware-store term.

USAGE:
- Covers most handheld electric saws in everyday speech. For specialized tools, more specific terms are used: ⟦{丸|まる}のこ→丸のこ：30201_marunoko⟧ (circular saw), ジグソー (jigsaw), ⟦チェーンソー→チェーンソー：30211_cheensoo⟧ (chainsaw), レシプロソー (reciprocating saw).
- Frequently seen in DIY magazines, construction contexts, and product listings.
- Contrasts with ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧のこぎり (hand saw), operated by arm motion alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電動|でんどう}のこぎり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut with a power saw
- {電動|でんどう}のこぎり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a power saw
- {電動|でんどう}のこぎり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧: the blade of a power saw
- コー⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧{電動|でんどう}のこぎり: cordless power saw

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧のこぎり: hand saw — manually operated, non-electric.
- ⟦{丸|まる}のこ→丸のこ：30201_marunoko⟧: circular saw — saw with a round rotating blade.
- ⟦チェーンソー→チェーンソー：30211_cheensoo⟧: chainsaw — specifically for felling trees and heavy cutting.
- ジグソー: jigsaw — for cutting curves in wood.
